description: This file contains a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer for C# that enforces a rule preventing the use of ref parameters in interface implementations of 'IAddressable'. It defines a custom diagnostic with ID 'ORLEANS0002' related to disallowing reference parameter modifiers, primarily for code quality or consistency enforcement within the Orleans project.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class that identifies methods implementing 'IAddressable' interface with 'ref' parameters, and reports diagnostics if such parameters are found.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context to analyze method declarations and report diagnostics for violations of the 'no ref params' rule.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method syntax nodes to check for ref parameters in methods belonging to 'IAddressable' interface implementations.
